name: automabuild
description: AutomaBuild: the four components and the application that composes them, in one repository.

scripts.//: Every script runs across the workspace. A change in one component is meant to be provable from the root, in one command, without knowing which folder it landed in.
scripts.//prepare: npm runs workspace lifecycle scripts alphabetically, which put the runner before the safe-fetch it compiles against. Dependency order is stated here instead, once, where it can be read.
scripts.prepare: npm run build --workspace automa-safe-fetch && npm run build --workspace automa-durable-runner && npm run build --workspace automa-webhook-gate
scripts.//app: The application, addressed from the root so nobody has to cd first.
scripts.//editor: The editor is a Vite app, and dev is the only way to run it in watch mode.
